title: Covalent modification of iron oxide-poly(lithocholic acid) nanoparticles with folic acid or doxorubicin – an approach for enhanced cancer therapy
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,14246-14258
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08830A, Paper

This study explores the effectiveness against selected cancer cell lines of nano-engineered formulations composed of inorganic cores with steroid-based polymeric shells functionalized with either a targeting or chemotherapeutic agent.
